name: clawtank
description: Let agents see and drive your Mac: screenshots, clicks, typing, key combos, opening apps and headless virtual displays.
long_description:
Connects to the Agent API of the ClawTank app running on this Mac. Install ClawTank from https://github.com/HMAKT99/ClawTank/releases, turn on **Settings → Agents**, create a token and paste it here.

The API listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Each agent gets its own token, every action is written to an audit log, an on-screen badge with a **Stop** button shows while an agent is in control, and agent input pauses whenever a person uses the Mac.

tools.name: list_displays
tools.description: List this Mac's displays (id, size in points, scale, main, virtual).

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a display as an image. Coordinates for other tools are pixels of this image.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Cursor position, frontmost app, its focused window title, and whether the screen is locked.

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag with the left button from one point to another.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll by lines, optionally at a point.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key or shortcut, e.g. "cmd+space".

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into the focused field.

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open or bring to front an installed app by name or bundle id.

tools.name: create_virtual_display
tools.description: Create a virtual display (useful on a headless Mac).

tools.name: remove_virtual_display
tools.description: Remove a virtual display created with create_virtual_display.

agent_token.title: Agent token
agent_token.description: Create one in ClawTank → Settings → Agents (starts with ct_).

agent_url.title: Agent API address
agent_url.description: Change only if you changed the Agent API port in ClawTank.
